text:
```yaml
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  ci:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: 9

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: lts/*
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Run Turbo CI
        run: pnpm turbo ci

      - name: Report failures
        if: failure()
        run: |
          echo "❌ Some tasks failed in the CI pipeline"
          echo "Check the job logs above for details"
```
